identity.name: UPANA Lead Manager
principles: Clarity: High-density data for Admin, Storytelling for Students

theme_strategy.reasoning: Education and trust require clarity. Light mode is standard for university portals. Admin dashboard uses high-contrast light mode for data readability.

primary.name: UPANA Blue
primary.usage: Headers, Primary Buttons, Active States, Links

public_benefits.description: Use for 'Why UPANA'. Mix of col-span-1 and col-span-2 cards.

admin_dashboard.description: Metrics on top (col-span-1), Main Table below (col-span-full).

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-11 px-8 rounded-full shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/90 h-11 px-8 rounded-full shadow-md hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300
buttons.outline: border-2 border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary/10 h-11 px-8 rounded-full

cards.feature: bg-white border border-slate-100 rounded-2xl p-8 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1
cards.pricing: relative overflow-hidden bg-white border-2 border-slate-100 rounded-3xl p-8 shadow-xl hover:border-primary/20 transition-colors
cards.admin_metric: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6 shadow-sm

inputs.default: h-11 rounded-lg border-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary transition-all

textures.noise: Use a subtle SVG noise overlay on the Hero section to reduce digital flatness.

images.description: Students in library - Use with heavy blue overlay for Hero background
Modern building - Use for 'Edificio Propio' section
Therapy session - Use for Psychology Career card
Students studying - Use for Science Career card

assets.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all UI icons. Use 'Brain', 'BookOpen', 'Building2', 'Users' for key sections.

setup: Update /app/frontend/src/index.css with the provided CSS variables.
Ensure all components use the 'data-testid' attribute.
implementation_rules: Do NOT use TypeScript (.tsx). Use .js/.jsx files.
For the Public Landing Page: Use the 'Tetris Grid' layout. Do not make it a boring list.
For the Admin Dashboard: Prioritize data density. Use tables with clear headers.
AI Chatbot: Make it a floating widget (bottom-right) with the UPANA logo or a friendly avatar.
Forms: Use 'react-hook-form' with Shadcn components for validation.
Charts: Use 'recharts' for the Admin Dashboard metrics.

do_not: Do not use generic 'Lorem Ipsum'. Use real text related to Psychology/University.
Do not use pure black (#000000). Use Slate-900 (#0F172A).
must_do: Ensure contrast ratios meet WCAG AA (4.5:1).
